crossRefs.note: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half…

“This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.
If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.
But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.

translations.web: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.
translations.bsb: For the evildoers will be cut off, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.
translations.kjv: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.
translations.asv: For evil-doers shall be cut off; But those that wait for Jehovah, they shall inherit the land.
